title: This Is Not Advice (Bloomberg Beta's Roy Bahat) — 'How to be an author, with Eric Ries'
summary: Roy Bahat, head of Bloomberg Beta, releases a three-hour-plus interview with Eric on the inner life of being an author — from blog posts typed on a Palm Treo at Sand Hill Road Starbucks to the journey of writing Incorruptible. Part of Roy's This Is Not Advice series interviewing people about their jobs.
blockquote:
We learned that the writing comes last. Eric spent years trying out metaphors that fell flat, meetings that went nowhere, and typing out blog posts on a Palm Treo keyboard at a Starbucks on Sand Hill Road. This all happened before a single word of the manuscript existed.

A book isn't a longer blog post. And understanding the difference between those two mediums is most of the work.
blockquote_source: Roy Bahat, This Is Not Advice
